requirements: R1: Trace and fix the causal mechanism producing 401s in JwtAuthenticationFilter.
R2: Remove the stubbed coverage audit and implement genuine coverage for the JWT authentication.

slices.title: Fix JwtAuthenticationFilter causal mechanism for 401 errors
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to resolve the causal mechanism producing 401 errors in JwtAuthenticationFilter and provide real test coverage, so that valid API requests are successfully authenticated and the self-falsification cycle is broken.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an API request with a valid JWT token, When the request passes through JwtAuthenticationFilter, Then it successfully authenticates the user without a 401 error.
Given the need for actual test coverage, When running integration tests, Then the JWT authentication mechanism is verified directly without stubbing.
